entities.text: Mriunjay Yadav @ Pappu Yadav @ Mritunjay Kumar Singh
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.P.P. for the State and the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in connection with Mahila (Bhabua) P.S. Case No. 07 of 2024 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

It is further submitted that the investigation in the case against the petitioner is still continuing, but then he has not been given the benefit of Section 41A of the Cr.P.C.
3.

The learned APP for the State submits that the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.46826 of 2024(2)
dt.12-08-2024 offences for which the instant FIR has been instituted against the petitioner carries punishment of less than seven years, the said submission of the learned APP is not disputed by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and the informant.

sentences.text:
In view of the submission made by the learned APP, the anticipatory bail application is disposed of in terms of the order dated 13-2-2024 passed in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 3536 of 2024 (Naushad Ansari Vs. The State of Bihar).
5.

entities.text: Criminal Miscellaneous No. 3536 of 2024 (Naushad Ansari Vs. The State of Bihar)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The petitioner would be at liberty to file a representation before the concerned Superintendent of Police and the Investigating Officer of the case within a period of three weeks from today with a web copy of the order dated 13-2-2024 in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 3536 of 2024 (Naushad Ansari Vs.
the state of Bihar) and the concerned Superintendent of Police shall ensure that the Investigating Officer of the case strictly adheres to the directions contained in the the order dated 13-2- 2024 in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 3536 of 2024 (Naushad Ansari vs. The State of Bihar).
(Satyavrat Verma, J) Rishabh/-
